research_mode: official Ministry of Justice and HMPPS accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly releases change
verified_claims: Releases in October to December 2025 were 7% lower than in the same quarter of 2024.
limitations: The national comparison cannot be mapped to a parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly HDC releases
verified_claims: There were 2,624 HDC releases in the latest quarter, 23% fewer than in the same quarter of 2024.
limitations: The change is influenced by policy timing and not suitable for location scoring.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly ROTL
verified_claims: There were 105,920 ROTL incidences in the quarter ending December 2025, 25% more than a year earlier; 67% were work-related.
limitations: ROTL purpose and volume are operational measures without exact-address relevance.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly ROTL people and failures
verified_claims: There were 4,179 people with at least one ROTL incidence and 252 temporary-release failures; more than 99.5% of incidences did not result in failure.
limitations: Incidences and individuals use different denominators and must not be converted into a parcel risk rate.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Annual adjudications
verified_claims: There were 281,688 adjudication outcomes in 2025 and 62% were proven.
limitations: Prison adjudications concern conduct in custody and cannot represent community parcel safety.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Proven adjudications
verified_claims: Proven adjudications increased by 7% to 173,580 in 2025.
limitations: The institutional trend has no direct relationship to an address outside custody.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Adjudication offence groups
verified_claims: Proven unauthorised-transaction adjudications increased by 8% to 56,129 and disobedience or disrespect adjudications increased by 5% to 51,439.
limitations: Custodial disciplinary categories are not community crime categories.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Additional-days punishment
verified_claims: Additional days were awarded on 6,781 occasions in 2025, with an average of 16 days when awarded.
limitations: Punishment occasions and average days are custody measures and not spatial risk indicators.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly adjudications
verified_claims: There were 70,275 adjudication outcomes in October to December 2025; 62% were proven and additional days were awarded on 1,838 occasions.
limitations: Quarterly adjudications are institutional outcomes without parcel geography.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly proven adjudications and punishments
verified_claims: Proven adjudications rose by 3% to 43,749 and punishments rose by 5% to 133,015 compared with the same quarter in 2024.
limitations: Multiple punishments can arise from proven adjudications, so counts must not be conflated or used for parcel scoring.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly licence recalls
verified_claims: There were 14,349 licence recalls in October to December 2025, including 573 HDC recalls, 38% more than a year earlier.
limitations: Recall totals reflect supervision and policy and are not local incident counts.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly recall sentence groups
verified_claims: There were 6,320 ORA recalls, up 27% year on year, and 8,029 recalls from sentences of 12 months or more, up 48%.
limitations: Sentence-group recall statistics cannot identify a local threat.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Quarterly recall distribution
verified_claims: Latest-quarter recalls were about 38% 14-day fixed-term, 35% 28-day fixed-term, 25% standard determinate, and 1% standard indeterminate recalls.
limitations: The distribution is not comparable with periods before July 2025 because recording categories changed.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Justice and HM Prison and Probation Service
sources.name: Probation caseload
verified_claims: There were 248,568 offenders under probation supervision at 31 December 2025, 3% more than at 31 December 2024.
limitations: A national supervision caseload cannot be attributed to any property or neighbourhood.
